breaking_news.headline: Staying in a job for the health insurance? About 1 in 4 Americans do, a survey says
breaking_news.summary: About 24% of U.S. employees stay in unwanted jobs just for health insurance, a report out Wednesday finds. Up significantly since 2021, the uptick in "job lock" is a concerning sign for the U.S. economy.

breaking_news.headline: In South Dakota, public media endures a year after federal funding was wiped out
breaking_news.summary: We check in on one state public broadcasting network a year after President Trump signed a law ending federal funding of public media.

breaking_news.headline: A town renamed its festival 'AI Love Irondale Day.' Then came the comments
breaking_news.summary: The online outcry over the renaming of a summer festival illustrates the unease over the data center boom in the South.

breaking_news.headline: 'New York Times' alleges White House abuses legal system to intimidate reporters
breaking_news.summary: The New York Times will argue in court Thursday that the White House is abusing the justice system to intimidate reporters over a story that angered President Trump.

breaking_news.headline: A new threat in the Middle East sends oil over $100 a barrel again
breaking_news.summary: The price of crude oil is rising again following Houthi claims of attacks on tankers in the Red Sea. What could it mean for gas prices, inflation and the global economy?

breaking_news.headline: A town renamed its festival 'AI Love Irondale Day.' Then came the comments
breaking_news.summary: Irondale, Alabama, rebranded its annual festival around AI, leading to online backlash that provoked a return to the original name.

breaking_news.headline: Trump to impose double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries
breaking_news.summary: The United States will slap taxes of 10% to 12.5% on imports from 60 countries accounting for 99% of U.S. imports, charging that they have inadequately enforced bans on goods produced by forced labor.

breaking_news.headline: Justice Dept. drops 'New York Times' subpoenas under pressure from judge
breaking_news.summary: The Justice Department is dropping the subpoenas it filed demanding grand jury testimony and phone records from New York Times journalists after sharp questioning Thursday from a federal judge.

breaking_news.headline: Teen jailed for exam cheating in Guinea dies after sickle cell complications, father says
breaking_news.summary: Mamadou Djouma Bah, 17, was arrested and sentenced to prison for exam fraud earlier this month.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine's ousted defence minister insists on being reinstated
breaking_news.summary: Mykhailo Fedorov refuses President Zelensky's offer to accept an alternative post, as the battle of wills continues.

breaking_news.headline: India's 'cockroach' protesters and government to hold talks as stalemate continues
breaking_news.summary: The meeting comes hours after activist Sonam Wangchuk announced he was ending his 26-day hunger strike.

breaking_news.headline: France evacuates 20,000 as wildfires spread in south-west
breaking_news.summary: Most of those evacuated were tourists from campsites around Arcachon Bay in France's Gironde region.

breaking_news.headline: Saudis must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump
breaking_news.summary: The US president says the landmark agreement to help Saudis develop nuclear energy is dependent on it joining the Abraham Accords.

breaking_news.headline: Indonesian babies were trafficked to Singapore. What happens to them now?
breaking_news.summary: At least 12 babies have been trafficked from Indonesia to Singapore, but what will happen to them remains unclear.

breaking_news.headline: Google and Tesla shares plunge as AI spending rattles markets
breaking_news.summary: As major tech companies race to capitalize on a new wave of AI technology, investors wonder when financial benefits will appear.

breaking_news.headline: Pubs cheer business rates relief while other firms 'left out in the cold'
breaking_news.summary: Pubs welcomed the support package, while other High Street firms asked why they were left out.

breaking_news.headline: Lawmakers push for AI 'kill switch' after OpenAI models go rogue
breaking_news.summary: A new bill would let the US government order the shutdown of AI models that pose a public threat.

breaking_news.headline: Oil prices hit $100 for the first time since May

breaking_news.headline: UK mortgage rates rise to highest level for a month
